description: Header file defining the DistributionCaller template for intercepting distribution calls in the Abseil random internal namespace.

classes.name: DistributionCaller
classes.description: Template struct providing mechanisms to call or mock distribution functions within the Abseil random internal namespace.

methods.name: Impl
methods.description: Default implementation of distribution call, invokes distribution with provided arguments.

methods.name: Impl (mock version)
methods.description: Mock implementation that attempts to invoke a mock method, falling back to default if not available.

methods.name: Call
methods.description: Public method to invoke distribution call, choosing between real and mock implementations.
